descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S02 Convex at-rest encryption confirmed active for this account and deployment

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Convex at-rest encryption is confirmed active on the account through a settings check. At-rest encryption is confirmed active. (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Someone with access to the Convex team that owns round-companion (Tim or Daniela), and the deployment names from the 3.1 run record

When Open the Convex dashboard settings for the team, project and deployment, and Convex's security/compliance documentation for the plan in use. Capture what each says about encryption at rest.

Then Dated evidence shows at-rest encryption active for this account and for the deployment(s) UAT used

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 2 'Convex's at-rest encryption is active on the account'. Pass only if the evidence names this account or plan, not Convex in general (the OAT-05 standard: confirmed, not assumed). If Convex has no per-account setting, what counts is Q3.

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
